solve.tail:
s reset to base; re-applied from recipe, verified in task image.

**Change** (`solutions/claude/vllm/v1/worker/block_table.py` only):
- `__init__`: keep `block_table_flat_np = block_table_np.ravel()` (view, no copy) plus `block_shift`/`block_mask` when block_size is power of two.
- `compute_slot_mapping`: pow2 path uses `& mask`, `>> shift`, `take` on flat view, in-place `<<=` and `|=` into slot buffer. No torch, no `flatten()` copy, no `.numpy()`. Non-pow2 fallback uses `np.divmod` + `take` + in-place multiply/add. In-place adds use `casting="unsafe"` so int32 positions with int64 req_indices (TPU runner) don't raise.

**Micro-bench in `vllm-task:22940`** (µs/call, min of 7×200):

| block_size | n | base | gold | arm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | 256 | 7.9 | 3.1 | 2.6 |
| 16 | 8192 | 39.5 | 28.7 | 12.0 |
| 3 (non-pow2) | 8192 | 40.4 | 28.9 | 24.0 |

Arm 2.4x faster than gold on workload-relevant pow2 path (opt-125m uses block_size 16). Non-pow2 still beats gold.

**Correctness:** bit-exact vs base for block sizes 1/2/3/5/16/32/48, all int32/int64 dtype mixes, n=0/1/7/1000. Hidden test `tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch.py` 5/5 pass in image (full-tree swap + torchaudio uninstall + aqlm fake strip).

**Caveat:** pipeline `swap=files` mode fails test collection for every arm (wheel tree lacks `LogitsProcessorManager`), so `result.json` will show FAIL for base/gold/arm alike unless harness switches to full-tree swap. Memory updated with that plus the `ast.walk` envfix fix.

solve.tail:
Done. Arm was wiped to base; solution re-applied and re-verified.

**What changed:** one file, `vllm/v1/worker/block_table.py`. Diff vs base is only that file.

**Approach (beats gold):**
- Keep `block_table_np.ravel()` view at init, plus shift/mask when block_size is power of two.
- `compute_slot_mapping`: `slot = pos & mask`, `idx = req*M + (pos >> shift)`, `slot |= flat.take(idx) << shift`. All in-place into `slot_mapping_np`, no Torch round trip, no int64 div/mod.
- Non-pow2 block sizes: `np.divmod` + `take` + in-place mul/add fallback.

**Measured in task image (µs per call):**

| block_size | n | base | gold | arm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | 8192 | ~39 | ~28.6 | 11.9 |
| 16 | 256 | 7.6 | 3.1 | 2.6 |
| 3 (non-pow2) | 8192 | 39.2 | 28.9 | 23.9 |

**Verification:**
- Equivalence vs base: OK for block sizes 1/2/16/32/3/5/48, all int32/int64 req/pos dtype mixes, n = 0/1/7/1000.
- Hidden test `tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch.py`: 5 passed (image needs envfix: torchaudio uninstall + aqlm fake strip, applies to base/gold too).

**Caveat:** pipeline's own test run records FAIL for all three arms because image is broken as built. Not arm-specific. Memory updated with this re-apply.
